messages:
Asha Rao: Heads up — noticed ~120 accounts got duplicate onboarding emails starting 10:12 UTC. Looks like the 'welcome_sequence_v2' playbook fired twice for certain contacts after a recent filter tweak.
Miguel Torres: ugh. Any quick signal to find affected runs?
Asha Rao: yes — query below pulls playbook runs with 2+ sends within 30m for same contact_id.
Asha Rao: ```sql
SELECT contact_id, playbook_id, COUNT(*) as sends, MIN(created_at) as first_send
FROM playbook_runs
WHERE playbook_id = 'welcome_sequence_v2'
  AND created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY contact_id, playbook_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
Priya Patel: Thanks. I checked a handful — most are trials that started today; a few are enterprise trials (account tag = enterprise-sso). Some already got enablement invites twice. Not great for NPS.
Joan Li: Is this a config regression from the filter change yesterday? I can roll the change back but want a safe small-batch first.
Asha Rao: my thought: disable the latest filter propagation and rollback only for playbook_id 'welcome_sequence_v2' for 2 hours, then run audit/dry-run to confirm. If clean, keep rollback and deploy a fixed filter.
Miguel Torres: agree. Proposed command (internal CLI):
```bash
csctl playbooks update --id=welcome_sequence_v2 --patch '{"filter_propagation": "off"}' --scope=pilot-cohort --dry-run
```
Miguel Torres: to actually apply: remove --dry-run and scope to tag=enterprise-sso first.
playbook-bot: [automation] dry-run completed. 14 matches would be suppressed by the flag change. (run-id: rb-431234) :white_check_mark:
Asha Rao: good sign. Priya can we own communication for the enterprise cohort? we'll prepare an apology + clarify no data lost.
Priya Patel: on it. Draft message: "Hi — we sent a duplicate onboarding email earlier today; apologies. No action required. If you'd like to reschedule your onboarding, reply and we’ll help." OK?
Asha Rao: yep. Also need an ops ticket to root-cause the propagation logic and a unit/regression test to catch duplicate-fire scenarios.
Joan Li: creating ticket now -> OPS-8281. I'll attach the query results and the change diff. ETA for rollback (pilot): 10m if no objections.
Miguel Torres: I'll monitor logs and put a temporary alert on duplicate send rate.
Priya Patel: I'll queue the customer messages and put a short banner in our onboarding doc.
Asha Rao: thanks team. Post-rollback checklist: run the query again, export affected contacts, mark them with tag 'duplicate-onboard-2026-03-22' for downstream dedupe, and schedule a replay job if we want to resend to missed folks.
playbook-bot: [automation] OPS-8281 created by Joan Li.
Miguel Torres: :thumbsup: rolling in 2m.
Priya Patel: :pray:
Asha Rao: Leaving notes: action owners Miguel (rollback + alert), Joan (ticket + logs), Priya (customer comms + tagging), Asha (audit + replay decision). Will follow up in 1h with status.
Priya Patel: thanks all.
Joan Li: Rollback complete. Verified 0 new duplicate sends in the last 20m.
Asha Rao: great, thanks. Scheduling deeper postmortem tomorrow AM.
